evidence.title: Web Design Inspiration : The Best Website Design Ideas

name: Web Design Inspiration
summary: Free gallery of website design ideas, updated daily and browsable by website type, industry, style and colour.
description: Editorially curated gallery of real website designs, updated daily, where each entry shows a design and links out to the live site. The filter tool combines industry (agency, fashion, gaming, SaaS, crypto …), website type (corporate, ecommerce, mobile app, portfolio, web service, magazine/blog …), style (clean, minimalist, dark, futuristic, illustrative …) and colour; an Editor's Picks collection and a blog with reviews and deals sit alongside. A free account stores favourite designs.
contains: gallery of live website designs, updated daily
filters: industry, website type, style, colour
each entry links out to the original website
free account to save and organise favourite designs
